flows.title: Import contacts from a CSV
steps: On the Audience page, select Import in the top right, then hover on CSV and click Upload CSV.
Choose your CSV file. By default, use at least Email, First Name, Last Name, User Group and Source columns.
Review any duplicates or missing information before finishing the upload.
View the newly uploaded contacts on the Audience page.

flows.title: Save an audience segment
steps: On the Audience page, add one or more filters to the contacts table.
Add a name for your segment.

flows.title: Create a mailing list
steps: Click the Create a list button.
Enter a name for your list and, optionally, a description.
